function.description:
API to fetch the count of discoveries using basic filters.

**How the filtering behavior works**

Each filter item provided in the query parameters will be applied simultaneously such that the result is the `AND` of all the filter items.
function.name: api_countDiscoveries

id.description: Optional list of the port channel ids to filter by.

name.description: The name of the discovery job. This will be a unique value.

responses.description: Reports a count, for example, a total count of records in a given resource.
responses.title: Count Response
